::: projects-header

Welcome to my portfolio of research, policy analysis, and data visualization projects.

My work explores questions surrounding public policy, political institutions, and social change through both quantitative and qualitative research methods.
:::

:::::::::: projects-section
::::::::: grid
:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: project-card
**POLICY RESEARCH**{.project-category}

### Irish Social Housing Policy

An examination of housing affordability, institutional barriers, and social housing provision in Ireland.

Drawing on my experience working in the Irish Parliament, this research explores the structural challenges affecting housing accessibility and considers alternative approaches to social housing provision.

**Research Areas:** Housing Policy, Public Administration, Comparative Policy

[View Irish Housing Project](projects/irish-housing.qmd)
:::
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: project-card
**DATA VISUALIZATION**{.project-category}

### U.S. Population Trends

An exploration of county-level population and demographic changes in the United States.

Using R and ggplot2, this project visualizes population trends and demographic characteristics to better understand changes across communities.

**Tools:** R, ggplot2, Data Visualization

[View Population Trends Project](projects/population-trends.qmd)
:::
::::

:::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
::: project-card
**UNDERGRADUATE RESEARCH**{.project-category}

### Undergraduate Thesis: Political and Social Thought

An independent undergraduate research project completed through the Political and Social Thought program at the University of Virginia.

This project reflects my interest in political theory, social questions, and interdisciplinary scholarship.

**Research Areas:** Political Theory, Social Thought, Interdisciplinary Research

[View Undergraduate Thesis](projects/thesis.qmd)
:::
::::
:::::::::
::::::::::
